title: Fema / RBI | All Saturdays Are Not Bank Holidays: PIB Debunks Fake Gazette Notification
description: PIB Fact Check says the viral Gazette declaring every Saturday a holiday for public sector banks is fake. Only second and fourth Saturdays are bank holidays.The post All Saturdays Are Not Bank Holidays: PIB Debunks Fake Gazette Notification appeared first on TaxGuru.
